sv.title: Ny elprognos: ”Blir en riktigt dyr vinter”
sv.summary: Elpriserna i södra halvan av Sverige stiger åter brant och kan denna veckan nå den högsta snittnivån hittills i år. Samtidigt visar en ny prognos att elpriserna i vinter riskerar att bli högre än under elkrisen 2022–2023.

en.title: New Electricity Forecast: "It Will Be a Very Expensive Winter"
en.summary: Electricity prices in the southern half of Sweden are rising sharply again and could this week reach the highest average level so far this year. At the same time, a new forecast shows that electricity prices this winter risk being higher than during the 2022–2023 electricity crisis.
